notes: Implicit caching is on by default for Gemini 2.5 and newer. Explicit caches exist only through generateContent on Gemini 3 and 2.5, not in the Interactions API or on Gemini 4, so 'you never created a cache' is not a valid finding there. On Gemini 4, a turn that adds fewer than 2,050 tokens re-processes the last 2,050 tokens of the previous request at the standard rate. Cached tokens appear as usage.total_cached_tokens. TTL and discount are not published, so they are null.
